name: Vorsha the Lasher
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Vorsha the Lasher's attacks threaten the Horde's foothold on Ashenvale's coast. The nearby naga honor the hydra with an offering brazier on an offshore island. Muglash means to extinguish its flame and draw Vorsha ashore.

sections.title: A Terror from the Deep
sections.body:
On Ashenvale's northwestern coast, Zoram Strand is one of the most dangerous stretches of shore. Zoram'gar Outpost holds a narrow strip there, facing hostile wildlife, night elves, and serpentine invaders. Vorsha the Lasher is among the strand's worst threats. The gargantuan hydra strikes the outpost without provocation.

She surges from the surf to crush its defenses and butcher its warriors. Then she vanishes into the deep tides.

sections.title: The Brazier of the Naga
sections.body:
The nearby naga honor Vorsha's ravenous violence. On a rocky outcrop offshore, they keep an offering brazier burning for her. Muglash, an orc set on ending the outpost's constant harassment, has found a way to draw the hydra out.

Defiling the ritual flame will enrage the naga guardians and Vorsha. In her fury, the hydra will surge to the surface, giving the defenders a chance to draw her into an ambush instead of waiting for another slaughter.

faq.answer: Vorsha the Lasher is a massive, fierce hydra that haunts the waters off Zoram Strand. She often attacks Zoram'gar Outpost without provocation, destroying its defenses and slaughtering Horde personnel.

faq.q: Why do the naga honor Vorsha?
faq.answer: The naga of Zoram Strand honor Vorsha for her unrelenting ferocity and destructive appetite. They keep an offshore brazier burning in tribute to her wicked nature.

faq.q: How is Vorsha lured out to fight?
faq.answer: Muglash leads an assault on the island where the naga tend Vorsha's brazier. Extinguishing the sacred flame enrages the naga guardians and Vorsha, driving the hydra to the surface to retaliate.
Muglash is an orc stationed at Zoram'gar Outpost. Tired of Vorsha's unprovoked coastal attacks, he plans to snuff out the naga's ritual brazier and fight the beast alongside dependable allies.

faq.q: Why is Zoram'gar Outpost vulnerable to coastal beasts?
faq.answer: Zoram'gar Outpost is an isolated frontier camp on Ashenvale's exposed beaches. Naga dominate the sea ruins while wild hydras patrol the surf, leaving the outpost open to amphibious attacks from all directions.

faq.q: What happens after Vorsha is slain?
faq.answer: After Vorsha is slain, the victory is reported to the Warsong Runners maintaining the lines at Zoram'gar Outpost. The frontier guards' constant burden eases, and the immediate coast is secured from sudden assault.

angles.text: Defending Zoram'gar Outpost preserves the Horde's northern foothold in Ashenvale and its logistics, though supply lines there face constant attack.
As an orc, you may share Muglash's refusal to cower behind makeshift palisades. He chooses to charge into the surf and hunt predatory beasts face to face.
